newsitem.title: BRAZIL: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BRAZIL, June 10 - Vitoria - Six vessels berthed of which 1 bulk wheat discharger, 2 cellulose loaders, 1 steel tube loader, 1 iron ore loader, 1 container/general cargo loader/discharger. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 2 Steel products loaders, 1 coal discharger. Portocel - 2 Cellulose loaders. Ubu - No vessels, 20 waiting in roads. Santos - 21 Vessels berthed of which 2 full container dischargers, 1 bulk cement, 1 bulk chemical products discharger, 2 general cargo discharger/loaders, 2 bulk soy loaders, 2 fertiliser dischargers, 6 sugar loaders, 1 bulk juice loader, 2 salt dischargers, 1 diesel loader, 1 fuel oil loader. 20 Vessels waiting in roads, 94 due over the next 7 Days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 2 Steel products loaders/dischargers. Ultrafertil - No vessels. Rio Grande - Seven vessels berthed of which 2 full container loaders, 2 soy loaders, 1 general cargo loader, 1 chemical products loader, 1 fertiliser discharger. 1 Vessel waiting in roads, 21 due over the next 10 days. Rio de Janeiro - Nine vessels berthed of which 1 wheat discharger, 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 1 container/general cargo discharger, 1 steel products discharger, 2 paper dischargers, 2 general cargo/steel products loaders, 1 sugar loader. Tecon - 1 Vessel, 26 due over the next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 4 Vessels berthed. Commercial quay - 1 Vessel, 4 waiting in roads, 6 due over the next 7 days. Paranagua - 13 Vessels berthed of which 4 fertiliser dischargers, 5 general cargo dischargers, 1 sugar loader, 2 pellets loaders, 1 soya loader. 22 Vessels waiting in roads of which to load, 10 sugar, 7 pellets. To discharge general cargo, 24 vessels due over next 7 days.

CHILE, June 9 - Arica - Three vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant. 12 Vessels due during week. Iquique - Three vessels berthed and operating, 4 berths vacant. 9 Vessels due during week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant. 12 Vessels due during week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. Valparaiso - One vessel berthed and operating, 8 berths vacant. Pier 2 out of service for enlargement until April 1998. 13 Vessels due during week. San Antonio - Five vessels in port operating, 5 berths vacant. 14 Vessels due during the week. Port working normally. Puerto Montt - One vessel in port, 2 due during week.

Punta Arenas - Three vessels berthed, 8 due during week. Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed, 5 due this week. No vessels in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed operating, 9 due during week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels berthed, none due during week. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, none due during the week. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, 2 due during the week. Oil terminal - No vessels berthed, none due during the week. Lirquen - Five vessels berthed, 1 berth vacant. 2 Vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels berthed, none due during the week.

COLOMBIA, June 10 - Barranquilla - Three vessels berthed (1 bulker, 2 general cargo). 19 Due (3 bulkers, 8 containers, 8 general cargo). No delays expected. Cartagena - Four vessels berthed (1 bulker, 3 general cargo). 10 Due (1 bulker, 6 containers, 3 general cargo). No delays expected. Santa Marta - Six vessels berthed (2 bulkers, 1 containers, 3 general cargo), 2 anchored (1 bulker, 1 containers). 10 Due (1 bulker, 2 containers, 7 general cargo). Waiting times, bulkers/containers 1 day. Buenaventura - Eight vessels berthed (4 bulkers, 3 containers, 1 general cargo). 25 Due (8 bulkers, 12 containers, 3 general cargo, 2 pcc). Waiting times, bulkers 3 days, containers/general cargo 1 day.

PERU, June 9 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Four vessels anchored. 6 General cargo/container vessels berthed. No berthing delays. Paita - No vessels anchored. 1 General cargo vessel berthed. No berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco, Ilo - No vessels, no delays. Talara One vessel anchored. Oil tanker berthed. No berthing delays. Chimbote - Three vessels anchored. 4 Fishmeal vessels berthed. No berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, June 9 - Puerto Cabello - Three vessels anchored. 13 Vessels berthed of which 7 grain cargo, 2 general cargo, 4 containers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Pier platforms 25-29 being repaved as from 2/6, with 90 days estimated as duration of work. The flagstones at piers 8-11 are also being replaced and this is expected to take 45 days. Guanta - Four vessels anchored 6 vessels berthed of which 2 grain cargoes, 1 general cargo, 1 containers, 2 fishing vessels.
